title: Dilated Hankel determinants
summary: For a sequence $\mathbf a=(a_0,a_1,\dots)$ we define its dilated Hankel determinant $\ddot{H}_n(\mathbf a)=\det(a_{2i+j})_{0\le i,j\le n-1}$, the minor of the infinite Hankel matrix $(a_{i+j})$ formed from the even-indexed rows and the first $n$ columns. We prove that, for a broad class of sequences, $\ddot{H}_n$ admits a remarkably simple product evaluation.
